description.value: JINYA Ramen Bar is a Japanese ramen chain known for broths simmered in-house for over 20 hours using whole pork bones, chicken, vegetables, and classic Japanese seasonings. The Langley location offers a contemporary sit-down dining room alongside a full bar with Japanese-inspired craft cocktails and a menu of small plates. It sits in a commercial unit along Fraser Highway and is part of a rapidly expanding North American franchise founded by Tomo Takahashi.
